posts.description: I got a replacement credit card yesterday; someone in Pennsylvania tried to buy pizza with my old one. It's been years since someone stole my credit card info. I wonder if the timing has something to do with that PHP vulnerability a few weeks back.

posts.title: Milestone: 55 Million Hits
posts.description: Wow, it's the site's 55 millionth hit. These "hits" aren't a measure of humans visiting pages; that count would be much lower. It's just requests to the website: every time a robot visits some page, the count goes up. If a human views a page that contains a dozen graphics, those graphics cause another dozen hits. So "a million hits" isn't as impressive as it sounds. But hits are easy to measure so
View of # SFHellscape behind the Parnassus Ave Coffee Bar. (omitted: also got a shot of a rainbow, but alas couldn't convince my very clever smartphone that the rainbow was the interesting part)
